title: orbit-plugin.yaml
description: The manifest of an orbit plugin: what it contributes to orbit and how it is run.

name.description: Lowercase letters, digits and dashes. It is also the command: `orbit <name> …`.

version.description: Version of the plugin, shown by `orbit plugin ls`.

api.description: Version of the plugin protocol the plugin was written for.

minOrbit.description: The oldest orbit that can run the plugin.

run.description: The process orbit talks to. Needed for everything except a plugin that only has a command.

cli.description: What `orbit <name> …` runs; the arguments are passed as typed.

events.description: What the plugin wants to be told about. `log` is every line of every service: ask for it only if you need it.

actions.description: Commands: an entry in the palette, and a key if you give one.

serviceSections.description: Blocks added to the detail of a service.

serviceColumn.description: A column in the list of services, with the badges the plugin sets.

headerBadges.description: The plugin shows badges in the header.

serviceTypes.description: Values of `type:` in orbit.yaml that the plugin runs.

command.description: The command and its arguments, without a shell. Paths starting with ./ are in the folder of the plugin.

sidebar.description: `services` puts the list of services on the left, like the Graph view.

panes.description: The first one goes on the left, the rest are stacked on its right.

bind.description: A pane declared before this one: this one is asked again whenever the selection of that one changes.

follow.description: A text pane that keeps its end in view.

wrap.description: A text pane that breaks its long lines instead of cutting them (a detail always does).

sized.description: Asked again when its width changes: the context carries the width of the pane.

key.description: An action of no view works everywhere, so its key must be alt+<key> or f1-f12. The user can change it in config.json.

item.description: About the selected item of its pane: not offered, and not run, while there is none.

title.description: The question. {item}, {service} and {<input name>} are replaced.

badge.description: Up to four letters, next to the services of this type.
